newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Utilicorp NZ raises offer for councils' PNZ shares.
newsitem.headline: Utilicorp NZ raises offer for councils' PNZ shares.

text.p: Utilicorp NZ said on Thursday it would, on or after October 1, raise its offer for local authorities' shares in Power New Zealand Ltd to NZ$7.25-$10 per share.
Utilicorp NZ, which is 79 percent owned by Utilicorp United Inc, is involved in a takeover battle with Auckland-based Mercury Energy for Power NZ.
The offer is directed at four local authorities which jointly hold 6.86 percent of Power NZ.
Mercury holds 32.4 percent of Power NZ and is bidding for more shares at prices ranging from NZ$7.25-$10/share.
Utilicorp has declared a relevant interest in Power NZ of 43.79 percent. Power NZ shares last traded at $8.00.
